t: Assorted pack of shims and packers with locking slots for stackability. Can be used to fill gaps or spaces between objects such as in the installation of frames, windows, and window sills. Also suitable for levelling of floors, tables, or chairs in toilets, bathrooms, subfloors, or exterior elements.
